async def act(page):
    # Navigate directly to the Orders page using relative URL
    await page.goto('/admin/sales/order/index/')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # On the Orders page, filter for fraud suspect orders
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='Status').select_option('fraud')
    # Sort by creation date ascending to get the earliest order
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Created').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Get the customer name from the first row of the orders table
    customer_name = await page.get_by_role('row').nth(1).get_by_role('cell').nth(0).text_content()
    return customer_name
